confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors use Portugal price-index averages adjusted upward modestly for Sintra’s tourist core; local menu prices vary widely. Coffee and lodging are less certain, and lodging is a holistic estimate. Cocktail and wine estimates use local menu prices relative to draft beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Portugal-wide restaurant benchmarks, with Lisbon as an upper comparator; Sintra’s high visitor demand lifts central prices while neighborhood eateries remain closer to national averages.
